data.narrative:
Vyriy Drone is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Oleksiy Babenko, with $4M+ in total capital raised via M&A activity in 2025. The valuation universe comprises 10 peer companies across Defense & Security—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems—though narrow-stage peer comparables proved unavailable.

Of two valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses the $4M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage progression, yielding an implied value of $5M. Peer-Median analysis was not executable; while 24 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers produced fewer than three datapoints, making median-based triangulation unreliable and potentially misleading.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4M (low) to $6M (high), with a median point estimate of $5M. This range reflects conservative application of stage-progression mechanics alone. Primary uncertainties include the absence of comparable Growth-stage transactions in the Defense & Security drone market and limited transparency into Vyriy's revenue, customer traction, and technical differentiation relative to the identified peer set. Additional fundraising activity or customer wins would warrant revaluation.
